**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant. I confirmed this by:

- Searching "solicit", "hire", "recruit" (no hits at all), plus "induce", "employee" and "personnel" (hits only in unrelated contexts — joint IP definitions, Committee representatives, FTE cost allocation, indemnitee lists, anti-corruption reps).
- Reading Article VIII (Certain Covenants) in full: it covers only diligence obligations (8.1(a)), conflicts of interest in pricing (8.1(b)), and product-level exclusivity (8.2, restricting Commercialization of Competing Products — not hiring).
- Confirming Article XVIII (General Provisions) has no such covenant.

This sits at our **preferred position** — no non-solicit binding Ono as Customer. The absence benefits our party, so nothing is flagged.
